description: The bar chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with various language families and individual languages, as studied in the paper "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models." The horizontal axis represents the number of tasks, ranging from 0 to 80, while the vertical axis lists the language groups and individual languages: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The data reveals a significant variation in task counts across these categories. IE-Slavic has the highest number of tasks, with a value of approximately 79, followed by IE-Romance with around 47 tasks and IE-Germanic with about 45 tasks. The Uralic language family has approximately 20 tasks, while IE-Baltic and IE-other have around 17 and 16 tasks, respectively. The IE-Indic and Semitic categories each have approximately 12 tasks, Turkic has about 6 tasks, and Basque has the fewest, with approximately 4 tasks. The bars are color-coded, with each language group or individual language represented by a distinct color, and the chart is sorted in descending order of the number of tasks.
